mentions.name: Scenema
mentions.description: A platform for creating whiteboard and 2D animated explainers, using AI to maintain character and voice consistency across videos. Originally aimed at cinematic AI videos, where short model clip lengths make longer videos hard to manage, it now generates minutes-long explainers up to 30 minutes with studio-level animation in whiteboard and 2D styles.
mentions.problem: Traditional animated explainers are very expensive and time-consuming to produce, and AI video models' short clip lengths make character and voice consistency difficult to manage in longer videos.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small tema and I are currently building https://scenema.ai, a platform for creating whiteboard and 2D animated explainers.
mentions.author: beemaestro
